transactionAssertions.oldActive: revision 1 active is validated, copied into archived with archived manifest status, and restored on failure
transactionAssertions.newActive: revision 2 is copied from fixed draft into a temporary directory, validated as active and atomically renamed into active
transactionAssertions.resolver: new sessions bind revision 2; existing sessions resolve their active-or-archived bound revision; draft is excluded
transactionAssertions.retry: a one-shot publication fault retries to one archived revision 1 and one active revision 2

notCovered: This is test-isolated repository activation evidence; no shared user profile directory is mutated during validation.
authorConclusion: Formal A activation candidate is transactionally verified and ready for responsible audit; it is not a manual activation or a commit/push authorization.
